newsitem.title: UK: No UK early economic policy statements likely.
newsitem.headline: No UK early economic policy statements likely.

text.p: No economic policy statements or news releases from Britain's Treasury are likely until later in the week, a Treasury official said on Sunday.
Gordon Brown, Britain's new Chancellor of the Exchequer, is spending the day in the Treasury for a succession of briefings and meetings but no news is expected to come out yet, the official said.
"We are all beavering away and we will have something for you later in the week," he said.
